title: Sales Trend Analysis
description: Analyze sales figures and surface the top growth trends for a target audience.
prompt: Analyze last quarter's sales figures and identify the top 3 growth trends for the leadership team.

title: Python Function Generator
description: Generate a Python function for a described behavior, optionally with type hints and a docstring.
prompt: Write a Python function that validates email addresses, with type hints and a docstring.

title: Short Story Writer
description: Write a short story on a topic to a target length and tone.
prompt: Write a 500-word short story about a robot learning to cook, in a humorous tone.

title: Document Translator
description: Translate text between languages, optionally preserving code snippets.
prompt: Translate this technical document from English to Spanish, keeping code snippets unchanged.

title: FAQ Extractor
description: Extract frequently asked questions and answers from source documentation.
prompt: Extract the top 10 FAQs from this product documentation for a help center.

title: Weekly Status Report
description: Turn raw project updates into a status report for stakeholders.
prompt: Generate a weekly status report from these project updates for stakeholders.

title: Step-by-Step Instructions
description: Write step-by-step instructions for a task at a given skill level.
prompt: Write step-by-step instructions for setting up a home Wi-Fi network for beginners.
